The persona value is cast loosely.

terms.meaning: The part of the app that remembers who is signed in.
A user type or work style chosen at sign-up.
Using the app without a personal account.

Values a parent component passes in when it uses this component.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports screen and store tools
sections.what: Brings in the animation library, icons, form memory and the authentication and profile stores.
sections.why: Likely reason: the screen needs motion effects, icons, and the stores that handle sign-in and profiles.

sections.name: AuthViewProps
sections.title: Declares the loading input
sections.what: Says the parent can pass in an extra loading flag, which shows the spinner and disables the submit button.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the app keep the form busy while it does work elsewhere. Reason not stated.

sections.name: AuthView (part 1)
sections.title: Form memory and submit logic
sections.what: Stores what the user types, plus any error and whether a request is in progress. On submit, sign-up creates the account, sets the dark theme and persona, and saves the profile name and role. Log in only checks credentials. Failed steps show a message.
sections.why: Likely reason: one form covers both modes, so the logic switches on the chosen mode.
sections.watch_out: Sign-up sets the theme to dark every time, which overrides any earlier theme choice.

sections.name: AuthView (part 2)
sections.title: Screen layout and mode tabs
sections.what: Draws the dark background, glowing shapes, logo and the two tabs for log in and create account. Switching tabs clears any error.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives the app a styled front door. Reason for the sliding tab highlight not stated.

sections.name: AuthView (part 3)
sections.title: Error box and sign-up fields
sections.what: Shows a red error box when there is an error. In create account mode, shows the required full name field and the optional role field.
sections.why: Likely reason: collects the extra details needed to create a profile.
sections.watch_out: The name field's placeholder is only hint text and is not a saved value.

sections.name: AuthView (part 4)
sections.title: Persona, email and password fields
sections.what: In create account mode, shows the persona dropdown. For both modes, shows the email field and the required password field.
sections.why: Likely reason: standard fields for identifying the user and setting access.
sections.watch_out: The password field only requires something to be typed, so any minimum length or strength rule must come from the auth store.

sections.name: AuthView (part 5)
sections.title: Submit and guest buttons
sections.what: Shows the main action button, which changes wording by mode and shows a spinner while busy. Below it, the guest button skips the form and enters the app as a guest.
sections.why: Likely reason: offers a quick way in without signing up.
sections.watch_out: Guest mode skips email and password entirely, so guest data is not tied to a login.

summary: The login and sign-up screen that lets someone log in, create an account, or enter as a guest.
purpose: Controls access to the app and sets up the profile of a new user.
why: Likely reason: the app needs an account or guest mode before showing the workspace. Reason for the visual style not stated.
how: The user chooses log in or create account. Sign-up asks for name, optional role, persona, email and password. Submit calls the store's register or login function. After a successful sign-up, the theme is set to dark, the persona is saved, and the profile name and role are synced, with the role defaulting to Systems Architect. Errors appear in a red box. The guest button calls loginAsGuest directly. A spinner shows while the request is busy.
inputs: The typed name, role, persona, email and password. The isAuthLoading flag from the parent. Store functions register, login, loginAsGuest, updateSettings and syncUserProfile.
outputs: A signed-in session through the auth store, plus settings and profile changes after sign-up. Error text on failure.
risks: Password rules are not checked here beyond the field being required, so the store must enforce them. Sign-up always sets the dark theme. Guest mode skips credentials entirely. Error text from the store is shown to the user as is.
debug: If sign-up fails with an unclear message, check the error text returned by register in the auth store. If the profile name or role is wrong after sign-up, check syncUserProfile. If the button stays disabled, check the parent's loading flag and the local loading state. If guest mode fails, check loginAsGuest in the auth store.
